title: Jamming at Pop Monroe's with Lester Young in Kansas City
summary: He had met Lester before Basie while jamming at Pop Monroe's place that sold needle whiskey.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Did Lester ever mention him -- cause he worked with him briefly --
I don't remember. I don't remember Lester speaking of him but it's a possibility.
Did you first meet Lester with Basie or had you met him before?

No I met him before. We used to jam. Going jamming and up in Kansas City, we used to go to a place called Pop Monroe -- Pops Monroe. And he used to sell needle whiskey. They called it needle whiskey. It was corn but it was cured by a needle. And he had a pen up at his house and we used to go there and play all night long. Several guys. I just can't remember all the guys that used to go.
